column1: # Loanwords whose Taraškievica form is lexically, not phonologically, conditioned.
# First entry for a key wins. Lowercase; case is re-applied at lookup.
# §71 genitive singular -у; forward-only — see the note in exceptions.tsv, the reverse
# аналіз stays masculine: the feminine аналіза is the historical variant, and the
# masculine lemma is what a deterministic converter should emit. Genitive аналізу is
# already the Narkamaŭka form, so nothing moves.
